name: 买单吧
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=买单吧
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = creditcardapp.bankcomm.cn, creditcardapp.bankcomm.com, creditcard.bankcomm.cn, creditcard.bankcomm.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/creditcard\.bankcomm\.(com|cn)\/tfimg\/public00\/M00\/[a-zA-Z0-9]{2}\/[a-zA-Z0-9]{2}\/[a-zA-Z0-9-]{30}\.(jpg|jpeg)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/creditcardapp\.bankcomm\.(com|cn)\/mappweb_interface\/common\/(qryPopAds|qryLaunchAds)\.do/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/creditcardapp\.bankcomm\.(com|cn)\/mappweb_interaction\/appInfo\/appNewestVersion/i then reject(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/creditcardapp\.bankcomm\.(com|cn)\/rcg\/index\.html\?callbackurl=rcg\/index\.html&orclogin=1&/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/mdb.js") with enable=${mddjba_enable}, tag="mdb", timeout=60, requires_body=true
